stories.title: Houthis launch sixth ballistic missile at Marib city
stories.summary: Houthis launch sixth ballistic missile at Marib city Houthis have fired a sixth ballistic missile on the Yemeni city of Marib, according to the Marib governorate. In a post on X, the governorate published photos of a crater in the ground as well as the mangled remains of a vehicle.  The statement added that ongoing assault “threatens the lives of civilians, displaced persons’ camps, and residential neighbourhoods”. Earlier, the governorate said a civilian was injured in a fifth missile hit on a bakery in Al-Sharika neighbourhood, while four ballistic missile and four drone attacks that preceded it caused injuries to people and damaged homes, cars and other civilian property.

stories.headline: Home province of DeepSeek, Moonshot founders seeks to retain, attract future AI talent

opening: China’s southern manufacturing powerhouse of Guangdong province welcomed nearly 40 computer science students from Tsinghua University this week, part of a targeted push by local authorities to bridge a widening gap in China’s artificial intelligence race by attracting top-tier talent from Beijing.
Despite raising two of China’s brightest minds in artificial intelligence – Moonshot AI founder Yang Zhilin and DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng – Guangdong failed to retain either.
